articleTitle: Quantitative quality indicators of the invariant spatial method of compressing video data
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The estimation of quality of the restored images on the basis of value of a peak ratio signal/noise for test images is provided. The estimation of compression coefficients is provided. The method of efficiency estimation of the advanced technology of compression on the base of method of invariant spatial coding on the basis of value of integral metric - absolute increase of delivery time in case of integration of advanced technology on into the aviation communication systems is developed.

Author Keywords: reduction of time of data delivery

articleTitle: Increasing wavelengths utilization efficiency in OTNoDWDM network based on local resource distribution method
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is devoted to increasing the efficiency of utilization of wavelengths in optical fibers in modern DWDM systems. Today's optical network architectures are very complex and consist of several layers. While the basis of all architectures is an optical DWDM layer, the implementation of the upper layer technologies can significantly vary what makes integration of the layers very challenging task. Considering that almost all traffic today is packet based and optical layer is circuit switched it is necessary to develop a sophisticated algorithms that are able to achieve optimal utilization of the optical circuit-switched infrastructure. Especially this is relevant for networks that are already deployed but have to deal with constantly growing volumes of traffic. One of the reasons for inefficient utilization of optical infrastructure is a lack of unified control plane across all network layers that is able achieve higher utilization of optical resources. For this reason we have developed a local resource distribution method that enables more effective distribution of traffic flows across the set of wavelengths of the single fiber with help of layer 2 OTN switching capabilities and transparent tunnel establishment. In order to estimate the effectiveness of the proposed method we develop an optical network simulator.

articleTitle: Fractal geometry based resource allocation for 5G heterogeneous networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In future dense heterogeneous networks (HetNet) with massive data transmission from multiple devices, load balancing problem becomes more important due to higher variability of small cells load. Small cell load variability is higher because of shorter cell radius that results in more frequent handovers in the HetNets. Therefore, new approaches are needed to solve the problem of effective resources allocation and load balancing in HetNet. In this paper, we propose a new resource allocation method for multi-tier HetNet based on the fractal geometry. Proposed approach is scalable to various network topologies regardless of cells size due to fractal geometry pattern. In order to assess interference and capacity in HetNet we develop fractal based frequency reuse.

articleTitle: LTE EPS network with self-similar traffic modeling for performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An important task in parametric synthesis of telecommunications network such as EPS network is to determine QoS parameters when traffic processed on EPS network nodes. In this conference paper, presented mathematical models for the calculation of QoS parameters such as delay and loss probability taking into account properties of self-similar traffic. This modeling based on model P/P/1 with Pareto distribution function for between packet intervals and processing time for case then intervals between packets and the duration of processing on servers are limited. Proposed model compared with model with log-normal and Weibull distribution of packet processing time and M/M/1 model.

articleTitle: Enhanced flow-based model of multipath routing with overlapping by nodes paths
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Enhanced solution of topical scientific and practical problem associated with the development of flow-based model of multipath routing with paths overlapping by nodes in Telecommunication Network (TCN) was presented. This model is further extension of the well known multipath routing model based on the introduction to the structure of non-linear constraints responsible for the calculation of routes that intersect just at nodes. It is possible to obtain the order of multipath routing by overlapping by nodes paths in the solution of nonlinear programming problem with given objective function, linear constraints and nonlinear terms. Search for a compromise on the providing fault-tolerance and network security, on the one hand, and quality of service, on the other, led to the fact that in some important cases the requirements for overlapping paths can be slightly reduced and it is allowable to use paths overlapping only by network nodes. Simulation results confirmed the efficiency of the proposed model. Among the advantages of the proposed model of multipath routing with overlapping by nodes paths, one can distinguish the fact that with the same parameters of security and fault-tolerance can be achieved higher performance and quality of service parameters in TCN in a whole.

articleTitle: Effective solution for scalability and productivity improvement in fault-tolerant routing
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Effective solution for scalability and productivity improvement in fault-tolerant routing using the flow-based model was proposed. In practice, the fault-tolerant routing based on reservation of network resources is usually associated with decrease in overall performance and scalability of protocol solutions. In this regard, in structure of the model introduced conditions that are responsible for the fact that the primary and backup routes differed only by network elements for which redundancy provided. This was reflected in modification of objective function within the formulation and solution of optimization problem of the fault-tolerant routing. Numerical examples showed efficiency of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Investigation of queue utilization on network routers by the use of dynamic models
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Results of investigation of impact factors to queue utilization dynamics on telecommunication network routers were presented. As was shown by the analysis, use of dynamic model, obtained by applying a Pointwise Stationary Fluid Flow Approximation (PSFFA), demonstrated that the average queue length converges to a steady state value for some time, which can range from few to tens of seconds. It is determined that the use of the steady state estimations when calculating the average queue length is possible only after the end of the transient process. Otherwise, it is advisable to use a more accurate differential model. As the results of the analysis, the duration of the transient process is influenced by such factors as the flow rate, capacity of the router interface, service discipline, etc. Within this research it was shown that the use of non-linear differential model can improve the accuracy of the calculation of the average queue length, depending on the state of the interface and the selected service discipline.

articleTitle: The method of crypto-semantic presentation of images based on the floating scheme in the basis of the upper boundaries
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: To create combined systems to hide video information resource, based on the technology to eliminate the redundancy with the preservation of the integrity and efficiency of information transmission, the method of crypto-semantic presentation of images based on a floating circuit system of polyadic coding in the basis of the upper boundaries is worked out.

articleTitle: An analysis of SDN-OpenStack integration
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is devoted to analysis of integration of SDN solutions to the OpenStack. Architecture of networking OpenStack module or Neutron and plug-ins for communication with SDN is considered. Different types of SDN controllers also considered in the paper. An experimental model of SDN-OpenStack integration was created according to the solution. Such characteristics of SDN-OpenStack solution as delay, max amount of UDP and TCP flows obtained in the experiment.

articleTitle: The multifractal load balancing method
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The load-balancing system, built on the basis of a subsystem load balancer and subsystem control and monitoring that closely interact with each other was propose in work. This system is presented as a queuing system with priority service discipline. In the described queuing system parallel processing flow applications occur in the multiple serving devices and successive junction of them into unified stream is done. The method of multifractal load balancing is submited on the basis of the developed system of load balancing.

articleTitle: Study of queuing system G/G/1 with an arbitrary distribution of time parameter system
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analysed the structure of multimedia traffic. On the basis of the analysis modelling of network traffic processing program ns2 was carried out. We consider two special cases of queuing systems of the general form: P1/W/1 and P2/P3/1. The correlation properties of the generated program ns2 sequences of time intervals between packets and packet processing time interval have been studied. The study led to the conclusion that for a theoretical analysis of systems G/G/1 equation Lindley may be used. The simulation estimates were obtained for delay values in the queue for the two cases. Then the delay in line is assessed with the use of analytical apparatus queuing theory based on the solution of the equation Lindley spectral method.

Author Keywords: approximation of the sum of decaying exponential

articleTitle: Overview of wireless technologies for organizing sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper deals with review of the main technologies of wireless access that are used in modern wireless sensor networks (WSN). Comparative analysis of access technologies for the most important parameters is provided. Main advantages and disadvantages for applying these technologies in WSN are reviewed.

articleTitle: LTE RAN and services multi-period planning
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimization model for the LTE RAN network planning that aimed to accounting of services multi-period planning. The analysis of experiments results showed that formulation of the problem, which is shown in paper and presented as a problem of MILP, allows to obtain the correct solutions from the practical point of view. Comparison of the result showed that usage of multi-period network and services planning increase the profit margin to 10% more than the proposed by us previously method.

articleTitle: Flow-based model of hierarchical multicast routing
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper the flow-based model of multicast routing was researched. To improve the scalability of the network the hierarchical approach of the network is used because usage of centralized schemes is very resource-intensive. Due to disagreement of solutions obtained on routers and thus appearance of the link overloading and the subsequent package lost we proposed to use the goal coordination method. The usage of this method allows distributing flows through links without its overloading and improving quality of service and increasing the efficiency of network management.

articleTitle: The Pareto chart of caries intensity evaluation for children with allergic diseases
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An Information and Communication Technology for caries intensity evaluation for children with allergic diseases is proposed. The method is based on a Pareto chart and a digital convergence prism. The Pareto chart is one of the seven basic tools of quality control. The method has been tested during the clinical examination of 110 children of individuals by using a probe, mirror and cotton rolls, and simply counts the number of decayed, missing (due to caries only) and restored teeth.

articleTitle: Application of different kinds of approximation in signals restoration
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article proposes the method of continuous signals restoration by different kinds of approximation: Lagrange polynomial, Kotelnikov interpolation series, linear and cubic splines, Haar wavelet and Kotelnikov-Shannon wavelet. The minimum value of mean-square deviation is used as a criterion. The program witch allows to define optimal method of different class of signals restoration is composed.

articleTitle: Calculation model of energy efficiency in optical transport networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper the model of determination of energy efficiency for the telecommunication network is described. The calculation is made to determinate the cost of electricity to the transmission of one bit of information (W/bit). The developed model will help to determine the cost of electricity between any nodes that will enable SDN controller to find the most energy-efficient route. The suggested approach can reduce the energy consumption of telecommunication networks, which are considerable for the operator. The paper presents an example of calculating the energy efficiency of telecommunications network.

articleTitle: Implementation of the software defined radio concept in terahertz range based on Wi-Fi
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Principles of signal-code sequence (SCS) are examined. New methods and technical solutions are proposed to select the type of signal structures in order to achieve the best throughput and performance in wireless communication channel. The information efficiency criterion for channel resources usage is proposed based on the analysis of indicators and criteria that are recommended in the standard 802.11a/n to select specific SCS. Testing radio link on length 1.7 km is performed based on a wireless interface MikroTik R52n-M; the SCS is identified which was automatically selected by software defined radio (SDR) system for data transmission, and compared with SCS recommendations in standards 802.11 a/n. The telecommunication system based on Wi-Fi technology in a range of 130-134 GHz is developed, and tested in the laboratory with achieving data rates up to 1.2 Gbps.

articleTitle: Optical losses at angle relative rotation in photonic crystal fiber connections
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper proposes a method of angular matching for two photonic-crystal fibers during the connection that will significantly reduce losses at join.

articleTitle: Organization of decision support systems for crisis management
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents structural logic schemes of building decision support systems in crisis situations with providing support for video conferencing based on heterogeneous networks. The proposed structural solutions allow implementing them with the use of any data transmission systems of the conditions of implementation of new compression technology based on the presented methods and models of adaptive encoding digital-out the images of preset quality. It is shown that the use of improved compression technology based on the methods for adaptive coding can be definitely implemented on H.32x protocol type platform without additional technical changes or communication equipment replacement and can achieve higher video transmission speed via communication channels.

articleTitle: Choice of reasonable variant of sygnal and code constructions for multirays radio channels
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In order to transmit the signals by multirays connection channels the method of Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing - OFDM is used. The main advantages of this technology are high resistance concerning selective fades and high frequency effectiveness. While constructing radio connection systems (RCS) with OFDM great attention is paid to the questions of creation the signal and code constructions (SCD) which permit to increase the speed to transmit the information in the limits of energy and the width of the working frequency band. The increase of the frequency effectiveness of RCS with OFDM for account of the concordance of the form of the transmitted signals and the type of modulation with parameters of the connection channel without the extra widening of the channel pass band and the increase of the power of transmitter is a rather urgent task.

articleTitle: The problem of finding a rational topology of wireless sensor networks using UAVs
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents a mathematical statement of the problem of finding a rational topology of wireless sensor networks (WSN) using unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), which consists of problem of sensor localization in monitoring zone and problem of UAV relays localization in the space for the organization of connected network with desired characteristics.

articleTitle: Neuro-fuzzy system for prediction of telecommunication channel load
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article presents the synthesis of neuro-fuzzy prediction system of network load in the telecommunication channel. The use of neuro-fuzzy system allows accurate prediction of the number of packets received within a predetermined time interval for transmission over a telecommunications channel.

articleTitle: Improving the method for load balancing of service flows based on local management of network resources in cloud systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper for improving performance and reduce the delay of providing services in cloud network has been proposed method for load balancing of service flows based on local management of network resources. The method consists in opening/laying of through the tunnel between the data centers for associations and flows regrouping requests for service. As a result, it was proved efficiency the method of opening/laying of through tunnels because its introduction can reduce the average delay transmission components service four times.

articleTitle: Data flows transmission models in converged optical access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents a new paradigm of optical data transmission based on resource grid forming. Unlike ordinary data transmission over Gigabit Ethernet network, we suggested optical wavelength-time division multiple access networks. The main difference of this method, is division the data between wavelength-time symbols. Thus, each user allocated on necessary set of wavelengths during fixed time interval. This feature allows eliminating the synchronization problem. Moreover, OWTDM method allows increasing the throughput utilization for both transport and access optical networks.

articleTitle: Texture detection in noisy images by combining several local parameters
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A problem of detecting textural areas in images corrupted by noise is considered. Detection is based on joint use of several local parameters calculated in scanning windows (blocks) of different size. Trained support vector machine (SVM) classifier is used for combining local parameters. Factors that influence detector performance are analyzed. It is shown that detector performance can be improved by taking into account information from classifier output for neighbor pixels.

articleTitle: Improvement of EIGRP protocol routing algorithm based on information security metrics
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Routing algorithm improvement in the ways of unequal cost for the EIGRP protocol with the introduction of such a measure as the risk of information security into the metric is proposed in this paper. It is proposed to evaluate the risk of information security using the methodology of the NIST CVSS standard and the theory of information systems survivability.

articleTitle: Dynamic correction of routing metrics by pervasive structural routing in the scalable distributed service networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Aim of this paper is the design of specific routing metrics correction algorithm for scalable and highly loaded by workflows service network. The most challenging idea is to use continuous dynamic correction of workflows' routing metrics by pervasive structural routing.

Author Keywords: weight coefficient of the routing metric

articleTitle: Results of development of tropospheric communications system
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The results of design and preliminary open path testing mobile tropospheric communication system are discussed. Practical recommendations to improve the characteristics of quality in mobile tropospheric communications systems are made.

articleTitle: The mobile system of urban area noise pollution monitoring
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the article the principles of the mobile system of local urban area noise pollution monitoring are investigated. The author substantiates the block diagram of the system, including the channel of information on the acoustic noise (measuring channel), reception of meteorological information channel (correction channel), a computing device. The features of the construction of channels and computing devices are considered. An example of the practical implementation of the system is also given by the author.

articleTitle: Linear model of bandwidth allocation in LTE downlink with RAT 1
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Linear model of bandwidth allocation in LTE downlink with RAT 1 was presented. The use of proposed model allowed to convert the solution of basic problem of bandwidth allocation in LTE downlink with RAT 1 to solving the optimization problem of Boolean programming with varying object functions. The linear character of model significantly reduces the computational complexity of final solutions on allocation channel (frequency) resource in LTE technology. Results of research the proposed model proved its adequacy in a number of computational examples.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic compatibility analysis of the infocommunication systems components on the flexible structures basis
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The design requirements analysis for the infocommunication systems components on the basis of flexible printed circuit boards taking into account their electromagnetic compatibility is performed in the article. The basic parasite parameters of multi-layered printed circuit boards are considered and the recommendations on their diminishing are formulated. Also the information of mechanical actions influence on the electromagnetic compatibility of electronic modules is presented.

articleTitle: Increment order of linguistic variables method in information security risk assessment
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: There is system analysis and information security risks assessment based on processing of linguistic variables. These variables are based on standard parametric trapezoidal fuzzy numbers with a fixed number of term sets. These standards are defined by experts at the initialization stage of basic units in the course of system setup. Its efficient use will increase, if there is a possibility of standards correction without the corresponding experts' involvement. To solve this problem, the implementation method of function transformation of linguistic variables standards based on a single increment number of terms using expert assessments made at the stage of system settings is proposed. This will simplify the procedure of standards adjustment, through the process of a single increment number of terms for trapezoidal fuzzy numbers.

articleTitle: HVS-based local analysis of denoising efficiency for DCT-based filters
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Images acquired and processed in communication and multimedia systems are often noisy. Thus, pre-filtering is a typical stage to remove noise. At this stage, a special attention has to be paid to image visual quality. This paper analyzes denoising efficiency from the viewpoint of visual quality improvement using metrics that take into account human vision system (HVS). Specific features of the paper consist in, first, considering filters based on discrete cosine transform (DCT) and, second, analyzing the filter performance locally. Such an analysis is possible due to the structure and peculiarities of the metric PSNR-HVS-M. It is shown that a more advanced DCT-based filter BM3D outperforms a simpler (and faster) conventional DCT-based filter in locally active regions, i.e., neighborhoods of edges and small-sized objects. This conclusions allows accelerating BM3D filter and can be used in further improvement of the analyzed denoising techniques.

articleTitle: Approximation of input distributions for queuing system with hyper-exponential arrival time
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Here it is shown that using queuing system with hyper-exponential distributions of arrival time and service time both of them can be approximated at the level of first two and three moments. Hyper-exponential distribution with two terms has coefficient of variation more than 1, so using it for approximation of any arbitrary heavy-tailed distribution is possible. Our results show that increasing third moment leads to decreasing average waiting time in queue in queuing system with fixed two first moments of distributions of arrival time and service time and the same load on the system. It turns out a significant impact of the third moment.

articleTitle: Method for OpenFlow protocol verification
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is devoted to SDNs verification. The main problems in deployment and maintenance process are analyzed. Methods of formal verification are suggest as way to check correctness and corresponds to the requirement. The modification of Model Checking proposed for verification the main feature of OpenFlow protocol.

articleTitle: The directions of development and implementation problems of telecommunication systems 5G wireless access networks, including mobile communications
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper discusses the need to define the concept of development of telecommunications 5G and the example of mobile communication subscriber in a mobile terminal moving on the highway at a speed of 250 km/h are discussed problems and possible variants individual technical solutions. Particular attention is paid to assessing the feasibility of the proposed solutions, which confirms the decisions of individual tasks.

articleTitle: Development of a search method of birationally equivalent binary edwards curves for binary weierstrass curves from DSTU 4145-2002
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the analysis of well-known methods of Edwards elliptic curves search. The suggested method is irrationally equivalent to the elliptic curves in Weierstrass form. The practical aspects of efficient software implementation of search irrationally equivalent curves algorithm are also considered in the paper. Authors describe a proposed modified search algorithm. Software implementation of modified algorithm has allowed finding birationally equivalent Edwards curves to curves from DSTU 4145-2002.

articleTitle: Methods of self-diagnosing in telecommunication networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In the presence of multiple faults (multiplicity no more than t) of system diagnostics. The conditions under which the status of each module of the system is determined only on the outcomes of testing modules having physical relation with him (conditions self-definable). The conditions diagnosed systems in cases where for any of the modules is not the conditions self-definable.

articleTitle: Method of effective syntactic description of frames using the contour information to improve the integrity of the video information resource
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It is shown that video information in the controlled from distance systems of collection of video information on the basis of side complexes of aeromonitoring utilized in behalf of type departments and the state makes informative resource. It is grounded, that for providing of safety of video information ponderable meaningfulness for the systems of aeromonitoring is had category of availability and integrity. The problem aspects of theoretical approaches are analysed in relation to treatment of video information for the increase of their availability and integrity. The necessity of creation of theoretical base and methods is expounded for the construction of effective syntactic description of context maintenance of videoshots with the use of intellectually of process of authentication video of the stages on the degree of their semantic maintenance. Development of model of informing syntactic presentation of contour video sequence is expounded in the system of intellectual treatment of videoshots. Conformities to the law, based on the exposure of locally-contour properties of contour video sequence of segment of videoshot, are additionally taken into account here.

Author Keywords: availability and integrity of a video information

articleTitle: Multipath routing as a tool for energy saving in transport software defined network
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The most important features of software defined networks are related to resource virtualization and centralized optimal control that is fully programmatically realized. In turn it gives rise to development of mathematical model which allows to find the optimal solution. On the other hand important role in optimization process belongs to criterion of optimality (objective function). Taking into account global world trends the paper offers mathematical model of SDN-driven transport packet optical network that allows to optimize network resources according to energy saving criterion. It will be shown that multipath routing over virtualized IP-links leads to saving 10% of power consumption per every additionally used path.

articleTitle: Converged solutions for next generation optical access
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article considers the model of a hybrid passive optical network based on convergent solutions. In order to implement the concept of optical next-generation access to analyse options for building optical networks with OFDM. In order to increase capacity and address the shortcomings of OFDM it proposed to use the method of N-OFDM.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of signal functions, built on the basis of quadratic and cubic splines
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Comparative analysis of extreme properties of selective signals, built on the basis of quadratic and cubic splines by means of eye-diagram aperture value criteria and energy redistribution in the signal, is carried out. It is shown that with optimum parameter selection one can obtain signals with necessary properties, it leads to simplifying the process of its practical realization at the stage of telecommunication systems design. In this regard the proposed method of the quadratic spline-approximation possesses sufficient realization simplicity, low computational complexity and adequacy of the standing practical problems.

articleTitle: The influence of geometric characteristis on a bandwidth of the photonic crystal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: We investigated the influence of GaAs pillars diameter on a frequency band in the case of 2D photonic crystal waveguide. The obtained result show that the bandwidth changes with changing of the pillars diameter. We also have shown that changing of diameter of pillars in the photonic crystal waveguide structure allows us to design optical filters.

articleTitle: OFDM signal formation with adaptive guard interval duration change
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The method of dealing with the phenomenon of intersymbol interference, based on a new OFDM technology, based on the adaptive OFDM-symbols cyclic prefix length changing, depending on the conditions of radio signals propagation, which allows to increase the effective bandwidth of fourth generation cellular networks in size from 17 to 30%, compared with the maximum value of the cyclic prefix length was improved. In particular, the method which allows the statistical analysis of the collected data on the mobile station power received signals allows to determine the optimal length of the OFDM symbols cyclic prefix. The principles of device building for adaptive OFDM-symbol cyclic prefix length changing in OFDM-signals shaping based on the proposed method were developed.

articleTitle: New steganographic method: Development and comparison with the most relevant
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Own method of embedding information in still pictures was synthesized. New algorithm used additional blocks of cropping and stability under the previous image processing. This ensured the reliability of the system and increased the probability of correct recognition of embedded data. The complex analysis of the most relevant data hiding methods by multiobjective optimization was done. Also the comparative analysis of the existing and proposed steganographic system based on quantitative and qualitative characteristics was carried out. Synthesized method showed excellent results regarding the most common methods and resistance to statistical stegoanalysis, finding no significant deviations of calculated parameters. Calculated characteristics also indicated a high level of invisibility of steganographic embeddings by the developed method.

articleTitle: Development of smart infocommunication networks for intellectual municipal services
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper represents the smart system that bypasses the normal functioning algorithm of traffic lights, triggers a green light when the lights are red or to reset the timer of the traffic lights when they are about to turn red. Different pieces of hardware like microcontroller units, transceivers, resistors, diode, LEDs, digital compass and accelerometer will be coupled together and programmed to create a unified complex intelligent system.

articleTitle: Model of network attack on the cloud platform OpenStack
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper is focused on safety analysis of cloud-computing solutions. The main construction stages of complex security systems for cloud computing are also addressed in the paper. An analysis of OpenStack architecture vulnerabilities regarding low-intensity Denial of Service (DoS) attacks is in focus. A model for evaluation of probability and timeline of DOS attacks tests is presented.

articleTitle: Choosing of optimal cluster size in WiMax mesh network under hierarchical cross-layer routing
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: A rational compromise between scalability and performance of WiMax mesh wireless network can be reached by hierarchical cross-layer routing. The paper offers appropriate mathematical model in space of state. The model describes dynamics of clustered mesh wireless network and allows to decompose initial control task into routing and slot allocation inside clusters, and routing and slot allocation between clusters. Simulation results show that chosen cluster size affects network productivity and complexity of optimization problem, its optimal value depends on average distance between source and destination, network size and network connectivity.

articleTitle: Method of data compression for traffic monitoring
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper a problem of compressing data containing information on basic parameters of network traffic is considered. Six test sets with different types of network traffic for known monitoring tool Wireshark are formed. Analysis of compression efficiency for these datasets by widely used archivers is carried out. It is shown that the main part of memory in compressed data relates to timestamps. A method for compressing timestamps that consists in delta calculation, Burrows-Wheeler transform (BWT), distance coding (DC) and recursive group coding (RGC) at the final stage is proposed. It is demonstrated that the use of RGC at the final stage provides more efficient coding compared to known methods. It is also shown that the proposed method of timestamps coding produces about twice larger compression ratio than WinRar.

articleTitle: Miniminno and minimaksno optimum control systems of communication networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The principles of optimum design of control systems in two main modes: stationary and automatic are given. The methods of finding of decisions adequate to these modes are offered.

articleTitle: Methodology of selecting appropriate technologies for constructing telecommunication access networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Description of a methodology for selecting appropriate technologies for constructing telecommunication access networks in the conditions of a specific locality is given. The methodology is used to select appropriate technologies for constructing the access networks of Ukraine's largest telecommunications operator (Ukrtelecom). Methodology may be useful for network owners (or designers) as a basis for developing their own support systems for decision making in the matter of developing next-generation telecommunication networks.

articleTitle: “laboratory information management system” information technology for production quality assurance of enterprise
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper analyzes how to integrate a holistic approach to the process of GMP regulation and parameter estimation of production and laboratory testing in order to improve the use of information technology in the process of ensuring the quality of products.

articleTitle: The evaluation method of coding efficiency of basic frames of the video stream in infocommunication
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Relevance of the questions connected to improvement of quality of provision of specific images with using of aeromonitoring. Need of enhancement of technologies of coding of a video stream is justified. Creation of a method for an assessment of algorithmic complexity for a method of processing of basic frames on the basis of diagonal-uneven positional coding of transformants in nonequilibrium base of the bases will be organized. Feature of the created technology from a position of algorithmic implementation is that diagonals have non-uniform length, quantity of discharges on codegrams are selected by diagonal non-uniform principle. Is shown that complexity of algorithmic implementation of the developed method of compression of basic frames is in the linear dependence from the frame size and generally is defined by the number of operations falling on execution of two-dimensional cosine transformation. The carried-out comparative assessment showed prospects of the created method on the basis of diagonal-uneven positional coding of transformants concerning its algorithmic complexity.

articleTitle: Modelling and evaluation of quality parameters of IP-networks connection
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: An important factor of development of modern telecommunication networks is to assure the efficiency of their work and proper parameters of quality of provided services. Therefore, the development and implementation of effective methods and facilities of connection quality assurance is the topical issue. The article deals with the analysis of problems of quality assurance in telecommunication networks, and some modern methods for solving the set task are considered on the basis of integrated IntServ and differentiated DiffServ service models.

articleTitle: Decreasing correlation in strongly correlated sequences using wavelets
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This article is about possibility of using the Lindley integral equation for the study of queuing systems. It is shown that for this purpose it is advisable to resample the implementation of traffic to uncorrelated samples. An example of using a fast algorithm of discrete wavelet transform for these purposes is also given.

articleTitle: Solution to a problem of routing in MPLS-TE network with additional directions of traffic transmission
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The application of nodal tensor method for solving the problem of routing in MPLS-TE network with additional directions of traffic transmission is proposed. An additional direction of traffic routing has been selected by the criterion of minimum time of packets delivery in order to ensure balanced load and reliability of a network.

Index Terms: Pairs Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Analysis of balancing process the subchannels number allocated to subscriber stations in WiMAX
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Method of balancing the number of subchannels allocated to subscriber stations in WiMAX network based on solution of optimization problem associated with maximizing the lower level allocated bandwidth for each subscriber station according to its QoS requirements for access rate was investigated. Research of proposed method confirmed the adequacy of the model and effectiveness of solutions as a whole in terms of providing different types of service level (with and without guaranties) to subscriber stations. Results showed that in balancing the number of subchannels allocated to subscriber stations with a deficit of network resource adaptive reduction of provided level of quality of service performed dependently on the type of possible guaranties and requirements regarding the access rate.

articleTitle: Cloud technologies development's process forecasting features
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Research of existing forecasting methods of cloud technologies development is given in the paper. Nowadays cloud computing became the most popular subject in the IT sphere and reached their development stage. In order to assess prospects of cloud computing technology's usage it's necessary to have forecasting method of its development in time both for short and long period. Here forecasting result is represented by time series serving a basis of cloud technologies' further development's graphical representation.

articleTitle: Qualitative evaluation method of IT-infrastructure functioning based on structural optimization of neural network
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: For today the unit neural networks are widely used to solve various problems. In this regard the issue of developing learning algorithm that would be able to optimize the structure of neural networks dynamically is very important. The existence of such a method would allow the researcher to get the structure of the neural network that would be best-answered domain and available input data quickly.

articleTitle: Bispectrum-based demodulation technique using triple-channel heterodyning of triplet-signal
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Paper is dedicated to novel bispectrum-based demodulation technique by using triple-channel heterodyning of triplet-signals. Test statistics used for triplet-signals detection and discrimination are evaluated in the form of the bimagnitude peak values. Experimental study of noise immunity in bispectrum-based digital communication system is performed for suggested triple-channel heterodyning technique. Bit error rate (BER) values are computed under additive Gaussian noise influence in radio communication link for wide variations of input signal-to-noise ratio (SNR).

articleTitle: Dynamic system model non-standard state analyses
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The research article is devoted to the functioning of research networks at unintentional traffic patterns. The article presents the variant of transient process benchmark that characterizes the parameters of modern telecommunication networks (TN). Qualitative adjectives analysis has been performed with the help of mathematical model of the digital filter Kalman-Bucy (FKB). The article also deals with the selection guideline of filter criteria and instability bounds at transiency conditions.

articleTitle: Functional management model in peer-to-peer networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: For rapidly progressive type of P2P-TV video transmission technology a rather general discrete-continuous mathematical model of video transmission in the form of differential equation of state was offered. On the basis of the generalized Lagrange equation the possibility of constructing a procedure to optimize the management of fragmentation is shown.

articleTitle: Managing embedding parameters of DCT coefficient steganography algorithms subject to the given value of the JPEG quality factor
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper addresses practical aspects of determining such values of image steganography algorithm embedding parameters, which will ensure a certain level of the final image distortion caused by the embedding itself and by the on-going compression with a given target quality level.

articleTitle: The study of statistical characteristics of signals at their processing in logarithmic detector
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The mathematical model of the demodulating logarithmic amplifier has been developed. The one-dimensional probability density of a random process at the output of the logarithmic detector has been obtained. Change in the law of distribution for different values of signal-to-noise ratio at the input has been investigated.

articleTitle: Mathematical tools for SDN formalisation and verification
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper is devoted to analysis of existing components and architecture of Software-Defined Networks. The main features of SDN and components interaction are considered. Based on the results we propose formalisms that define rules coordination and interaction of the main components and controls SDN architecture. The methodology and mathematical tools for formalization and verifying OpenFlow protocol are suggested. This methods can be transparently used to analyze critical requirements and properties prior to system implementation. For analysis and verification of OpenFlow protocol was designed formalism that allows checking out the requirements form different specification versions of OpenFlow protocol.

articleTitle: Development strategy bit rate control processing personnel predicts to increase the availability and integrity of information resources
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Strategy for bit rate control end equipment, which provides the best image quality for a given channel and the best time to process a single frame is considered. To implement the compression mechanism predicted frame is analyzed: format chroma subsampling, the decision threshold depending on the type of processing block in frame quality factor and quantization. The combination of selected options provides the flexibility to adapt to the required bandwidth while maintaining the required quality of the transmitted image.

articleTitle: Features of equalization in LTE technology with MIMO and SC-FDMA
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: LTE is one of the standards for mobile telephones of the next generation, that is why the article provides an overview of the basic methods in the LTE equalization with MIMO and SC-FDMA channels, where the maximum delay is greater than the length of the guard interval. The three methods of compensation: time interval and frequency domain turbo equalization are considered.

articleTitle: Hybrid method of self-organization of wireless sensor and actuator networks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Wireless sensor and actuator networks (WSANs) are used for longterm observation and monitoring. Such long-lasting deployments require different maintenance tasks, such as the replacement of nodes - motes, and the most critical initial installation of the sensor nodes. We propose the algorithm of the self-organization for wireless sensor and actuator networks, which determines the productivity of the network during operation. During maintenance, the actual motes placement is modified resulting in temporary topology fluctuations, which are very expensive in terms of energy. We analyzed an algorithm for constructing a route taking into account aspects of the effective energy usage of network objects.

articleTitle: Receiving OFDM signals in channels with scattering
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The algorithm of reception signals with orthogonal frequency multiplexing (OFDM) in channels with dispersion is considered. The offered algorithm is based on processing "in general" on an interval of dispersion of sequence of counting of the bending-around symbol OFDM for the purpose receiving estimates of maximum likelihood of this sequence with the subsequent formation solutions of rather transferred QAM - symbols according to the classical scheme with use of the FFT technology. For an assessment of a noise stability of algorithm statistical modeling is carried out it. It is shown offered algorithm in comparison with the classical scheme of processing of OFDM of signals possesses the best characteristics of a noise stability in channels with dispersion.

articleTitle: Multi-criteria choice of the preferred type of mobile phone by the analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The theoretical and practical aspects of applying the analytic hierarchy process to choose the preferred type of mobile phone based on combination technical and economic parameters of quality and expert judgment.

articleTitle: Analysis of efficiency for space-time processing of signals from subscriber stations in implementation of space-time division multiple access
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: It is shown that implementation of the method of space-time division multiple access with the individual space-time processing of subscriber stations signals which is reduced to the use of group elements of adaptive antenna array and the establishment of parallel procedures of assessing values of vector of weighting coefficients on the number of simultaneously working stations.

articleTitle: Definition of the period of control for the condition of technical means of infocommunication systems in MRP II manufacturing execution systems
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Analytical expressions for definition of the optimum period of control for a condition of technical means of info communication systems which provides a maximum of its availability quotient are received. The mechanism of checks and service of system taking into account errors of the first and second sort is described. Methods of the theory of regenerating processes of restoration received analytical expression of an availability quotient; existence of the optimum period of control is proved.

Author Keywords: error of the first and second sort

articleTitle: Thunderstorm hazards early warning system
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Systematic monitoring of the status and trends of the thunderstorm activity of a given region is caused by necessity to minimize damage from lightning. Particular attention is paid to the reliability of the thunderstorm activity forecast and the time of its formation. So a small time span between the formation of a reliable forecast of the storm hazards and the onset of adverse events does not allow you to take timely measures for minimization the damage caused. Particular attention is paid to the reliability of the forecast generated. Thus, an inseparable combination and implementation of these requirements allows you to solve the problem of optimal synthesis of an early warning system of thunderstorm hazards (THEW).

articleTitle: Automated mobile measurer of volume flow of liquids with microprocessor control
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The article describes the automated mobile measurer of volume flow of liquids in the composition of the executive unit with microprocessor control. The execution unit implemented the method of direct measurement of volume flow of liquids, which is invariant to the physicochemical properties of liquids. As containers used tapered dimensional volumes, the cone base converted towards each other. The hardware and software implementation of the functions of automated management and reference of volume flow is provided in the control unit microprocessor. Execution unit and control unit microprocessor provided as separate independent structures connected by electrical connectors.

articleTitle: The methodology of experimental researches and the software tools for Volterra model construction of infocommunication system
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: This paper presents the methodology and the software tools used for nonparametric nonlinear dynamical Volterra models constructing in frequency domain. The wavelets application allowed enlarging computational stability of the identification method for measurement noises filtering of received responses and characteristics of the system being identified. The proposed methodology and developed software tools were applied for different orders infocommunication system models construction.

articleTitle: Flow-based model of multipath routing with traffic policing rejection balancing
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Solution of actual scientific and practical problem associated with the development of flow-based model of multipath routing with traffic policing rejection balancing was presented. Within the proposed model consistent solution of problem of multipath routing with traffic policing rejection balancing converged to solution of optimization problem of linear programming with the optimality criterion as minimum of dynamically managed upper bound of rejections for all flows in a whole network. Numerical examples of multipath routing with traffic policing rejection balancing problem solving confirmed the adequacy and effectiveness of the proposed solution. Investigation of processes of multipath routing with traffic policing rejection balancing using the proposed model showed that the flow rate restriction on the network edge has an adaptive nature.

articleTitle: Development results the model distribution of troughputh in the WiMAX mesh-network
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The frequency resource distribution mathematical model is offered as a problem of subchannels' number balancing between radio channels formed by mesh-stations of the wireless network. The use of the offered model has made it possible to raise efficiency of the wireless mesh-network as a whole and ensure the “bottlenecks” absence.

articleTitle: Possibility's evaluation of optical processors usage for optical signals switching's control
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Feasibility of optical processors' usage in all-optical networks is evaluated in this paper. Model of all-optical switching device is examined. Conditions for optical processors' usage in all-optical switching devices are determined. Most promising optical processors in the field of optical technologies are suggested.

articleTitle: Dynamic model of multipath routing supporting traffic engineering queues with packets priorities
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: In this paper was developed a dynamic model of multipath routing based on balancing lengths of queues at the routers of telecommunication network represented by a system of linear differential equations of queue buffer utilization. The novelty of represented model is a modification of the conditions of balancing lengths of queues to take into account the priorities and lengths of packets in queues. Proposed model allowed to convert the solution of multipath routing based on balancing lengths of queues to solution of problem of optimal control. Using the solution proposed allows to organize a more effective control of buffer and link network resources due to the consistent solving of multipath routing and balancing lengths of queues problems in accordance with the concept Traffic Engineering Queues.

articleTitle: Some aspects of local-base transformation in non-stationary signals processing tasks
publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: The paper presents one of processing optimization algorithms, which is used for signals with nonlinear frequency modulation. Proposed optimization approach of weight processing is applicable to frequency domain. It is based on asymptotic approach that estimates spectral composition of the signal to select the areas of maximum energy concentration in frequency domain. Also the weighting filtering features of specified areas are considered.

publicationTitle: 2015 Second International Scientific-Practical Conference Problems of Infocommunications Science and Technology (PIC S&T)
abstract: Provides a listing of current committee members and society officers.
